discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/cis_2.2.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/cis_2.2.x/cis_2.2.14.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: 'Enabled' not in prelim_hyper_v_installed.stdout); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.2.14 | PATCH | Configure Create symbolic links"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_2_14
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.2.14
  block:
    - name: "2.2.14 | PATCH | Configure Create symbolic links | No Hyper-V Installed"
      when: "'Enabled' not in prelim_hyper_v_installed.stdout"
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
        action: set

    - name: "2.2.14 | PATCH | Configure Create symbolic links | Hyper-V Installed"
      when: "'Enabled' in prelim_hyper_v_installed.stdout"
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
          - NT VIRTUAL MACHINE\Virtual Machines
        action: set
